## Create Aeronautics: Translate

`Create Aeronautics: Translate` is a small **unofficial resource pack** for `Create Aeronautics` that provides additional **language files**.

It allows in-game text (items, blocks, tooltips, advancements, and related UI) to appear in more locales when the matching Minecraft language is selected.

This resource pack is designed to be used **alongside the main Create Aeronautics content** and does **not** add any blocks, items, or gameplay mechanics—only **localization**.

> **Important:** This is **NOT AN OFFICIAL RESOURCE PACK** and is not affiliated with the Create Aeronautics developers.

### Supported languages (12)

| Code | Language |
|------|----------|
| `en_us` | English |
| `ru_ru` | Russian |
| `de_de` | German |
| `es_es` | Spanish |
| `pt_br` | Portuguese (Brazil) |
| `pt_pt` | Portuguese (Portugal) |
| `it_it` | Italian |
| `pl_pl` | Polish |
| `tr_tr` | Turkish |
| `ko_kr` | Korean |
| `ja_jp` | Japanese |
| `ar_sa` | Arabic |
